notes.title: Huge game update!
notes.notes:
Game will have:
 - Totally new physics.
 - New graphics.
 - Tons pf new features.
 - New UI.
 - Better maps.
 - Game modes.

Release date: when ready. 

[previewyoutube=eH9XyEn_9R4;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: World Reaction is now better
notes.notes: World reaction to music now has better and smooth time, but the smoothness depends on how fast and how loud the music is.

notes.title: Music Fixed
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Fixed music not playing, some players had music not playing despite game having found them
[*]Fire bubble head is now slower
[*]Enemies have less shooting range
[/list]

notes.notes:

[*]After an enemy dies, ragdoll enables or another effect shows

[*]Back button fixed
[*]Better UI logic

[/list]

notes.title: Default music playlist added!
notes.notes: Now if you don't have any music on your computer, in-game music playlist will be played.
